item.title: Performance Engineered for the Modern Golfer
item.description: In a game where balance, precision, and confidence define success, footwear plays a far greater role than many golfers realise.

item.title: Del Rey, Schott share one-shot lead in Bahrain
item.description: Alejandro Del Rey and Freddy Schott sparkled during the opening round of the Bapco Energies Bahrain Championship to share the lead at seven under.

item.title: Vorster leads SDC Open after ‘being like a kid’
item.description: Martin Vorster's round of seven-under-par 65 earned him the lead in Thursday’s first round of the SDC Open at the Zebula Golf Estate & Spa.

item.title: Sundelson, Schiefner set for SA Amateur showdown
item.description: Judd Sundelson and Morris Schiefner secured their places in the final of the 2026 South African Amateur Championship.

item.title: Cronje cruises to Big Easy Play Off victory
item.description: Daniel Cronje marched to a dominant six-shot victory in the Betway Big Easy Tour Play Off event held at Modderfontein Golf Club.

item.title: Rose leads at Torrey Pines as Koepka makes PGA Tour return
item.description: Justin Rose conjured a bogey-free 10-under par 62 to grab the first-round lead at Torrey Pines.

item.title: Dismembered Ballesteros statue found
item.description: Spanish police have recovered pieces of a life-sized statue of golf great Severiano Ballesteros.

item.title: Hill races clear with course-record in Bahrain
item.description: Scotland’s Calum Hill surged into a commanding four-shot lead after equalling the course record with a flawless 11-birdie 61 at the Bapco Energies Bahrain Championship on Friday.

item.title: Giboudot chases history at SDC Open
item.description: France’s Maxence Giboudot fired a bogey-free eight-under 64 to take a one-stroke lead into the weekend of the SDC Open as he targets a place in the tournament’s history.

item.title: Rose stretches Torrey Pines lead, Koepka makes cut
item.description: Justin Rose carded a sizzling 65 on Friday to push his lead to four strokes at Torrey Pines, where Brooks Koepka made the cut on his return to the PGA Tour.
